themes.name: Standard Pack
themes.desc: The dependable blue-collar pack. Honest crinkle, honest heroes.

themes.name: Adventurer's First Pack
themes.desc: Extra-forgiving wrapper for brand-new heroes. Tears encouragingly.

themes.name: Guild of Gains Pack
themes.desc: Smells faintly of chalk and destiny. Rip with correct form.

themes.name: Night Court Pack
themes.desc: Half radiant, half nocturnal. The foil argues with itself.

themes.name: Gather-In Pack
themes.desc: Grows fancier with every step of the ladder. Aspirational packaging.

themes.name: Gather-In Pack (Second Rotation)
themes.desc: The ladder returns, now with commemorative duck embossing.

themes.name: Night Shift Pack
themes.desc: Printed after hours by moths with strong opinions about kerning.

themes.name: Ember Pack
themes.desc: Warm to the touch. The wrapper is technically smoldering.

themes.name: Tide Pack
themes.desc: Waterproof, which raises questions about how you're meant to open it.

themes.name: Bloom Pack
themes.desc: Compostable, sentient, supportive. Whispers 'you got this' as you rip.

themes.name: Dawn Pack
themes.desc: Glows softly. Very hard to hide from yourself as a treat.

themes.name: Dusk Pack
themes.desc: The foil is a small piece of night. Handle after sundown for best results.

themes.name: Anniversary Pack
themes.desc: Commemorates one full year of the meadow being mostly safe.

themes.name: Department of Doom Pack
themes.desc: Official villain merchandise. The foil files a complaint when torn.

themes.name: Event Pack (Assorted Nonsense)
themes.desc: Contents may include heroes, confetti, and one (1) fake-out.

themes.name: Revival Pack
themes.desc: Yesterday's legends, re-foiled. The nostalgia is complimentary.
